art_direction: 原创飞鸟由弧面与折角色块构成，胸部留白清晰，翼面细分而不写实。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Construct an original bird in mid-flight from flat curved planes and a few crisp folded angles. Show it almost frontally with one wing slightly higher, keeping the body a clear ivory shape through the center. Use ultramarine, muted peach, charcoal, and soft gray for the surrounding wing planes. Subdivide each wing into two or three larger areas rather than many feathers. Let small negative-space triangles suggest the tail and beak. The composition remains two-dimensional, without realistic shading, origami paper texture, or a recognizable species emblem. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
